text:
Rhea: Kickoff: OSS 'Keel' refapp launch. Deliverables: short get-started guide, bench blog with reproducible data, a 30-min livestream demo, and an inbound form for community leads. Target launch in 3w. Quick thoughts? :sparkles:

Omar: Love it. Bench narrative should show realistic app-level numbers (cold start, steady-state p95/p99, and token-cost per 1k for a typical FAQ flow). Provide the exact prompt set and seed for reproducibility.

Priya: I'll draft the tutorial (5-7 steps). Plan: CLI quickstart, run locally with Docker, then point to hosted variant. Need a single-file example app for copy-paste.

Design-Bot: Design can do a hero GIF and a small diagram of request flow. ETA: 3 business days for assets. Prefer 640x360 GIF for social.

Liam: For the demo, recommend: record a full walkthrough and keep one short live pipe in the stream to prove it works. Also add a fallback canned demo to avoid surprises.

Nora: For inbound routing, HubSpot form + UTM. Fields: email, company, interest (hosted/dedicated/private), use utm_campaign=keel_refapp_launch. Auto-tag leads with "keel-refapp" and sync to SFDC via existing mapping.

Rhea: Technical bench details: include a tiny harness (Python) + run command example and CSV outputs. Example: `python bench/run.py --model small-q4 --prompts prompts/faq.json --qps 40 --duration 180`. We'll commit raw CSV in /bench/results/*.csv.

Omar: I'll own the harness and generate a sample dataset. Use two profiles: 'interactive' (qps=10, latency focus) and 'bulk' (qps=200, throughput focus). Document exact hardware and model flags used.

Priya: Repo plan: one-folder quickstart, /tutorial, /bench, /src. README will show Docker snippet:```Dockerfile
FROM node:18-bullseye
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","server.js"]
```
Also include a tiny express example that hits Redwood API.

Liam: Add a small demo of KV cache savings. Show before/after token counts and cost delta. Could make a tiny chart in the blog.

Nora: Landing page content: 30s hero video, 3 bullets (faststart, bench highlights, join webinar) and CTA -> HubSpot. Add hidden UTM and deployment_interest fields. Track clicks with GA event 'keel_cta_click'.

Rhea: Timeline draft: Week 0: repo + tutorial skeleton + landing draft. Week 1: bench runs + blog skeleton + assets. Week 2: record demo + rehearsals + social copy. Week 3: launch + stream + followups (email drip).

Omar: CI: small GH Actions job to run smoke bench (short run) on push to main and publish artifacts. Workflow snippet:```yaml
name: bench-smoke
on: [push]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run smoke bench
        run: python bench/run.py --prompts prompts/faq.json --duration 10 --qps 5
```
We can store results as artifacts for traceability.

Priya: Webinar structure idea: 8m intro, 12m demo (pre-recorded fallback), 6m bench walkthrough + 4m Q&A. Keep demo safe: use a canned transcript for potentially volatile model outputs.

Design-Bot: Social snippets ready in /marketing/snippets/keel_launch.md. Suggest 2 variations for X and LinkedIn.

Nora: Lead nurture sequence: Day 0 welcome + tutorial, Day 3 bench deep-dive, Day 7 stream recording + office hours invite. Add tag for deployment interest to route to AE.

Rhea: Action owners: Omar (bench harness + blog coauthor), Priya (tutorial + repo), Liam (demo + video), Nora (landing + flows), Design (assets). I'll set publish date and Asana tasks.

Omar: Small extra: include a reproducibility section with exact commands, Docker image digests, and a link to raw CSV so community can replicate. This builds trust.

Priya: I'll draft the quickstart showing how to run locally and how to switch to Dedicated endpoint with one config change.

Liam: Need permission to record from staging hosted instance. Can someone open a ticket to infra?

Nora: I'll handle the HubSpot form creation and mapping. Will post the form embed code here when ready.

Rhea: Sweet. Let's sync Friday to confirm bench artifacts and rehearsal time. :rocket:
